snippet.description:
Bad Street Brawler was released for Nintendo's classic 8-bit NES console in September 1989. All audio/visual elements copyright 1989, Mattel. Music composed by ?

ABOUT BAD STREET BRAWLER (NES)

Specifically designed for use with the Nintendo Power Glove. The player plays the character, Duke Davis, who walks around with blond hair, a yellow tank top, sunglasses, and yellow pants as he beats up gangsters that get in his way. He is described as a former punk rocker and the "world's coolect" martial artist. Before the start of the next stage, quotes are introduced to entertain the player (i.e., Never trouble trouble until trouble troubles you). The player even has to beat up gorillas and old ladies who throw pocketbooks at the player (resembling weightlifter dwarves who throw dumbbells at the player). The "Trip" attack more closely resembles groping.
